item.title: Botswana announces prohibitions following suspected FMD cases
item.description: Botswana has announced various prohibitions and other measures following the recent discovery of suspected cases of foot-and-mouth disease (FMD) among livestock in its Masunga District. If this disease is confirmed there, it will put Botswana’s fiercely protected FMD-free status in jeopardy.

item.title: Record average price for Van Hasselt Angoras
item.description: Consistent quality proved to be the deciding factor at the Van Hasselt and guest seller Angora veld ram auction, held at the Willowmore showgrounds on 15 January.

item.title: BVI steps up regional response as FMD outbreak escalates across SADC
item.description: As foot-and-mouth disease (FMD) continues to pose a threat to livestock systems throughout Southern Africa, the Botswana Vaccine Institute (BVI) has announced several measures to support affected countries. The institute is deploying technical expertise and strengthening regional cooperation to contain the outbreak and safeguard the sector.

item.title: Bhambanana Abattoir: Millions spent, years lost and farmers still waiting
item.description: The Bhambanana Red Meat Abattoir in northern Zululand has stood largely unused and deteriorating for close to 14 years, despite many livestock owners in KwaZulu-Natal’s foot-and-mouth disease (FMD) management area having little to no legal means of earning an income from their animals.

item.title: ‘Is the outbreak of FMD a sign of SA’s deteriorating veterinary services?’ –Dr Rebone Moerane
item.description: South Africa’s Department of Agriculture has been struggling to contain and prevent the further spread of foot-and-mouth disease (FMD), a virus that infects livestock and impacts negatively on both farmers and consumers.

item.title: WATCH | From waste to wealth: ARC experts guide farmers on the biogas opportunity
item.description: At a recent field day held at Mme Moloto’s farm in Rooiwal, Pretoria (Gauteng Living Lab), Agricultural Research Council (ARC) researchers delivered a presentation that could reshape how South African farmers view their waste streams.

item.title: Great offer at second Elite Angora veld ram auction
item.description: The most expensive Angora ram offered by House of Fibre at the Elite veld ram auction, held on 22 January at the Botanical Sports Ground in Graaff-Reinet, fetched R40 000.

item.title: Regenerative agriculture project empowers smallholder farmers in Mozambique
item.description: Solidaridad, the HEINEKEN Africa Foundation, Kvuno and Hiveonline have launched the Promoting Regenerative Agriculture for Sustainable Livelihoods (PRASL) project in Mozambique. The project is aimed at strengthening smallholder farmers’ adoption of regenerative agricultural practices that restore ecosystems, improve soil health and build resilient rural communities.

item.title: How pineapple leaves can help fight pollution and crime
item.description: South African scientists have discovered that pineapple leaves, long regarded as agricultural waste, can be transformed into a powerful, low-cost material that tackles two pressing challenges: water pollution and forensic investigation.
